title: Fig Asks for Help at the Barn
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ou as u, ear as er, or as er.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ou as u, ear as er, or as er.

pages.text: A big leaf blocks the barn gate.
pages.illustration: A huge fallen leaf propped up against the entrance of an old barn, blocking the way in.

pages.text: Fig tugs at the big leaf.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar pulling hard at one edge of the enormous leaf.

pages.text: The leaf will not shift for Fig.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar straining, the huge leaf staying exactly where it is.

pages.text: Fig can not shift it alone.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar stepping back, looking at the leaf and then at the closed path ahead.

pages.text: Fig asks Ned and Moss for help.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar calling over to Ned the duckling and Moss the hedgehog nearby.

pages.text: Ned and Moss trot over to help.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling and Moss the hedgehog hurrying over to join Fig at the barn gate.

pages.text: All three grip the big leaf.
pages.illustration: Fig, Ned and Moss all gripping different edges of the huge leaf together.

pages.text: They pull, and the leaf slides at last.
pages.illustration: The three of them pulling together, the big leaf sliding away from the barn gate.

pages.text: The barn gate sits open and clear.
pages.illustration: The barn entrance now completely clear, the leaf pushed off to one side.

pages.text: Fig is glad of the help.
pages.illustration: Fig, Ned and Moss standing together at the open barn gate, all smiling.
